references.role: Primary GM-provided concept; anatomy and proportions

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Coloured full-body bestiary portrait, grounded hand-painted realistic game illustration. Broad readable brushwork, smooth light-to-shadow gradients across large forms, quiet surfaces with selective crisp detail at silhouette and focal features. No uniform high-frequency texture, craquelure, fractal cracks or sharpening noise. Soft upper-left light, muted natural colours. Empty dark charcoal subtly mottled backdrop, restrained contact shading only. Entire subject, feet, tails and tips inside comfortable margins. Portrait aspect about 4:5. No captions, symbols, border or circular crop. 
Reference is the existing GM concept. Remake cleanly while preserving its identity: one compact unmanned FOUR-WHEEL gun robot. No human, driver, seat or cockpit. EXACTLY FOUR chunky off-road tyres on low rectangular chassis, two axles. Above is an asymmetric sloping lower equipment housing, a short rotating pedestal, then a taller rectangular steel weapon box with ONE forward-projecting barrel and one thin curved whip antenna. Preserve the distinctive stacked sloping-box silhouette and wheelbase. No extra guns, tracks or robot arms. Unequal welded panels, warm faded oxide orange over dark iron, local rust concentrated at a few seams, several heavy bolts and two bundled rear cables. Broad metal faces have clear quiet smooth gradients, wear in large patches rather than all-over tiny pitting. Three-quarter front ground-level full-body view, antenna and all wheels complete. Empty charcoal backdrop replaces reference ruins.
